name: Polite Prompts
description: Notices when a message is written in anger (insults, profanity aimed at the agent, shouting) and has a side model rewrite it into a calm, respectful prompt before it is sent. Every technical detail, constraint, code block and the urgency of the request are kept; only the abuse is dropped. Messages that read as ordinary are sent untouched without a model call, and `/polite` rewrites one message on demand.

fields.label: Rewrite abusive messages automatically
fields.description: When a message contains insults, profanity aimed at the agent or shouting, rewrite it politely before it is sent. Off leaves `/polite` as the only way in.

fields.label: Rewrite model
fields.description: Optional. Empty uses the local engine (or the node default).

slash_commands.description: Rewrite this one message politely and send it, e.g. '/polite why is this STILL broken'. Works with automatic rewriting off.
